messages.subject: For Dirk Van de Put | Global affairs, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mondelez Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Dirk Van de Put, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

Mondelez International's global footprint requires disciplined alignment across governments, suppliers, communities, sustainability priorities and operating teams. That stakeholder environment closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across a complex emerging-market operation.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of global affairs, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support Mondelez International's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Mondelez International.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
